SLUG: PHILIPPINES-SEA-STANDOFF
HEADLINE: Philippine coast guard reports standoff near disputed shoal
DATELINE: MANILA, Philippines
RESTRICTIONS: No use by broadcasters in the region before 1800 GMT
BODY:
The Philippine coast guard said on Tuesday that two of its vessels were in a
standoff with foreign ships near a disputed shoal in the South China Sea.

A coast guard spokesperson said no shots had been fired and that the vessels
were holding position.
